strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Existing headless.run.drive can now fail closed when a second product completion decision attempts to reinterpret the same accepted-completion boundary.
Hardens the completion state machine so one accepted completion, terminal completion, and completion closure boundary has exactly one product stop-or-continue decision.
Rust enforces persisted boundary uniqueness after explicit decision authorization and before ledger append; VSIX remains transport-only.
Bounded next-action and replay metadata stays trustworthy because the ledger cannot accumulate two product-decision events for the same accepted-completion, terminal-completion, and closure boundary.
Headless replay can rely on bounded fingerprints and ids instead of reinterpreting raw review notes or Product Charter text.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting agent_loop, runtime_permission_enforcement, progress_visualization, and context_management.
answers.new_capability: Existing headless.run.drive now rejects a second product_completion_decision for the same accepted-completion, terminal-completion, and completion-closure boundary unless it is the exact persisted decision replay.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M51.3 recorded and replayed decisions by decision fingerprint, but did not explicitly fail closed on a different decision id, product status, or product-evidence fingerprint for the same completion boundary.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: A headless caller could reinterpret one accepted completion as conflicting continue-or-stop outcomes across retries if result reconstruction failed to surface the original decision before append.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M51.1 acceptance creation, M51.2 accepted-completion routing, and M51.3 product decision recording because this binds uniqueness to the accepted completion boundary rather than adding a new decision surface.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This hardens the existing headless.run.drive product_completion_decision path without adding a JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The behavior is a runtime denial before ledger append, not a report, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, dashboard, or summary wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust scans persisted product-decision events for the same task/run, accepted-completion, terminal-completion, and completion-closure fingerprints; exact replay remains idempotent, conflicting boundary decisions return an invalid params error and append no event.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless callers can trust that a completed product boundary has one durable runtime-owned stop/continue decision and cannot be silently re-decided by a later retry.
answers.milestone_progress: This repairs the final M51 product completion transition so the runtime completion state machine is ready for phase-complete assessment and milestone closeout.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M51.3.1 updates current and archived phase-value manifests for a runtime-owned product completion decision uniqueness repair. Review must confirm guard enforcement is not weakened and the diff implements fail-closed boundary uniqueness rather than a wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive permits exact replay of the persisted product_completion_decision for the same accepted-completion, terminal-completion, and completion-closure boundary
headless.run.drive rejects a second product_completion_decision with a different decision id, product status, or product-evidence fingerprint for the same boundary
conflicting boundary decisions append no additional HeadlessRunProductCompletionDecisionRecorded ledger event
the repair adds no new JSON-RPC method and no report/readiness/history/verdict/inspection/dashboard wrapper

RPC and ledger metadata remain bounded to ids, statuses, counts, category names, next action, and SHA-256 fingerprints without raw prompts, provider responses, final responses, file content, raw Product Charter or manifest text, diagnostics, stdout/stderr, command strings, environment values, raw request bodies, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_records_product_completion_decision_and_replays validates authorized product decision recording, exact replay, conflicting same-boundary decision denial, and single product-decision ledger evidence after conflict.

Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_blocks_invalid_product_completion_evidence validates insufficient product evidence remains blocked_by_product_evidence with repair_product_completion_evidence next action rather than false product_complete.

Existing M51.1 and M51.2 Rust tests continue to validate accepted-completion creation, accepted-completion routing, duplicate-free replay, and malformed accepted-completion denial before session mutation.
VSIX runtimeClient protocol tests continue to validate product_completion_decision request/result shape and raw product evidence field rejection without VSIX-owned policy.

accepted_capability: Existing headless.run.drive rejects conflicting product completion decisions for a persisted accepted-completion boundary while preserving exact replay idempotence
safety_boundary: Product decision uniqueness is bound to task id, run id, accepted-completion fingerprint, terminal-completion fingerprint, and completion-closure fingerprint
Exact persisted decision replay remains idempotent and duplicate-free
A different decision id, product status, or product-evidence fingerprint for the same boundary fails closed before ledger append
decision metadata contains only bounded ids, status strings, category names, counts, booleans, next action, and SHA-256 fingerprints
VSIX validates transport shape only; Rust owns product stop-or-continue policy and uniqueness enforcement
non_goals: No report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary-only wrapper
No automatic product completion without explicit authorization
No provider execution, tool execution, verifier retry, patch apply, workspace mutation, shell, git, network, or service expansion
No raw Product Charter or manifest text in ledger or RPC metadata
No milestone closeout in this implementation PR
rejected_alternatives: Adding a product decision inspection RPC was rejected because the bug is in runtime mutation admission, not in observability.
Relying only on decision_fingerprint replay was rejected because it does not bind uniqueness to the accepted-completion boundary.
Letting a later product_complete override an earlier continue_development decision was rejected because it would make completion replay non-deterministic.
Broad runtime modularization was deferred so this remains a bounded M51.3 repair.
technical_debt: crates/brownie-runtime/src/lib.rs remains large and should be split only in a cohesive future refactor.
M50.1 journey admission atomicity remains separate non-blocking technical debt.
Future milestone closeout should decide whether product-completion evidence should be generated from a richer internal Product Charter model rather than caller-provided bounded fingerprints.
next_capability_rationale: If this phase is accepted, M51 should proceed to phase-complete assessment and milestone closeout rather than another product completion wrapper phase.
